C wf020.sl-reachability OL WF-020,GOV-014 MUST ;; Do not upgrade packages during a scan unless asked; do not rate dependency findings from CVSS alone; consider reachability and exposure. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec001.sl-dev-not-exempt OL SEC-001 DEFINITION ;; appsettings.Development.json is not automatically ignored: a real committed secret remains a secret; obviously fake values may be ignored or reported as Info; UserSecretsId is not a secret. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec004.sl-safe-forms OL SEC-004 DEFINITION ;; Safe forms: ORM LINQ, parameterized SQL, the persistence technology's interpolation-parameterizing APIs, ADO.NET/Dapper parameters; ordinary LINQ with user input in a predicate is not SQL injection. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.sl-command-injection EX SEC-003 PREFER ;; Prefer APIs that separate executable and arguments; validate or constrain input when command execution is genuinely needed. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.sl-path-traversal EX SEC-003 MUST ;; Normalize and verify that user-influenced paths remain within the intended storage boundary. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.sl-deserialization EX SEC-003 MUST_NOT ;; Untrusted payloads must not deserialize into arbitrary runtime types (e.g. BinaryFormatter, unsafe TypeNameHandling). ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C sec016.sl-crypto-passwords OL SEC-016,SEC-008 MUST ;; Flag security-sensitive MD5/SHA1/ECB, hardcoded keys, custom hashing and home-grown protocols (not non-security checksums); passwords use established hashers, not reversible encryption; never recommend custom cryptography. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec006.sl-effective-policy OL SEC-006 DEFINITION ;; Determine the effective authorization policy; an endpoint without explicit [Authorize] under a secure fallback is not automatically vulnerable; bare [Authorize] is not automatically insufficient. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec006.sl-anonymous OL SEC-006 MUST ;; Confirm deliberately public surfaces ([AllowAnonymous]) are intentional; not every public endpoint is a vulnerability. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec005.sl-idor OL SEC-005 DEFINITION ;; Client-side filtering is not authorization. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec017.sl-token-validation OL SEC-017 MUST ;; Check that issuer, audience where applicable, signature/signing authority and lifetime are validated; flag intentionally disabled validation without valid reason. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.sl-no-arbitrary-clockskew EX SEC-017 MUST_NOT ;; Do not require manually setting every TokenValidationParameters property when authority/metadata configuration establishes secure validation, and do not impose an arbitrary universal ClockSkew. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C sec016.sl-no-custom-hashing OL SEC-016,SEC-018 MUST_NOT ;; Review local-account hashing, reset, lockout and enumeration behaviour; never recommend custom password hashing. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec005.sl-frontend OL SEC-005 MUST ;; Route guards and hidden/disabled buttons are UX; verify sensitive operations are protected by the backend. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec009.sl-cors OL SEC-009 DEFINITION ;; CORS is a browser-origin policy, not authorization; broad, credentialed-untrusted or Production-exposed environment origins are problems; AllowAnyOrigin can be valid for a public non-credentialed API; credentialed cross-origin access requires restricted origins. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec011.sl-csrf OL SEC-011 MUST ;; When browser credentials (especially cookies) are sent automatically review CSRF protection for state-changing operations; do not assume the frontend framework provides server-side CSRF protection. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec007.sl-tls OL SEC-007 DEFINITION ;; Disabled certificate validation, accept-all callbacks and plain HTTP for sensitive communication are findings, accounting for TLS termination; missing in-app redirection is not automatically a vulnerability. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec015.sl-uploads OL SEC-015 MUST_NOT ;; Client-provided MIME types are not authoritative (review size limits, path safety, names, content assumptions, serving risks and authorization). ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.sl-rate-limiting EX SEC-013,RUN-017 DEFAULT ;; Consider rate limiting where abuse realistically matters (login/password reset, expensive anonymous endpoints, resource-intensive operations); do not require it on every endpoint. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C sec010.sl-logging OL SEC-010,RUN-014 DEFINITION ;; Logs must not contain passwords, tokens, keys, auth secrets or full payment credentials; PII per project requirements; prefer technical identifiers; Debug/Trace is not a security boundary. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.sl-response-contracts EX ARC-029,SEC-010 PREFER ;; Prefer explicit response contracts where needed, but inspect the serialized fields before calling a returned entity a vulnerability. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C sec008.sl-data-at-rest OL SEC-008,SEC-016 DEFINITION ;; Choose data-at-rest protection from the requirement (password hashing; hashed verification tokens; protected storage for retrievable secrets; platform/database encryption; Data Protection for temporary payloads, not universal database encryption; never custom cryptography). ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec013.sl-fail-safe OL SEC-013 MUST ;; Security-sensitive checks fail safely (no allow on failed authorization service, token validation or permission lookup). ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec013.sl-silent-success OL SEC-013 MUST_NOT ;; Not every swallowed exception is a vulnerability, but security-relevant failures must not silently turn into success. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run019.sl-no-cancel-retry OL RUN-016,RUN-019 MUST_NOT ;; Review retries of state-changing operations for duplicate effects; caller cancellation is never retried. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf020.sl-exploitability OL WF-020 MUST ;; A theoretical missing limit is not automatically High; evaluate whether an attacker can exploit it. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec014.sl-visible-failure OL SEC-014 MUST ;; Prefer visible failure over insecure fallback in security-sensitive startup configuration (no silently disabled authentication, plaintext mode or allow-all). ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.sl-threat-modeling EX WF-020 MUST ;; When meaningful security-sensitive workflows exist, flag them for threat modeling or manual review instead of claiming the scan proves them secure. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C wf020.sl-no-mechanical-severity OL WF-020 MUST_NOT ;; Never map pattern, CVSS or OWASP category mechanically to severity. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf020.sl-no-invented-exploitability OL WF-020,WF-012 MUST_NOT ;; Never invent exploitability the code does not establish. ;; = ;; none ;;

136 NN ;; Heading.

C x.ss-static-limits EX WF-020 MUST ;; The scan is an evidence-based static review, not a penetration test, and cannot prove the application secure; state that limitation in the report. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C wf020.ss-concrete OL WF-020,WF-012 MUST ;; Report concrete risks, not generic security advice. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf020.ss-context OL WF-020 MUST ;; Evaluate findings in the context of actual exposure and application behaviour. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf020.ss-confirmed-severity OL WF-020 MUST ;; Every finding distinguishes confirmed evidence from items needing verification; severity comes from exploitability, reachability, impact and context, never from a suspicious pattern or raw CVSS alone. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec001.ss-dev-secrets OL SEC-001 MUST_NOT ;; Do not suppress a real secret because it sits in a Development file. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov013.ss-no-unneeded OL GOV-013,WF-012 MUST_NOT ;; Do not require security mechanisms the project does not need. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec006.ss-effective-authz OL SEC-006,SEC-005 MUST ;; Evaluate effective authorization behaviour including global/fallback policies. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf021.ss-tool-independent OL WF-021 MUST_NOT ;; The review must not depend on a specific MCP server, agent, analyzer, commercial scanner or external tool; available tooling is evidence, not the sole authority. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ss-scope-surfaces EX WF-020 MUST ;; Inspect which surfaces exist and skip irrelevant checks instead of reporting them as failures. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.ss-full-vs-targeted EX WF-020 MUST ;; A full pre-release or requested audit reviews all applicable layers; a targeted change focuses on affected layers and expands when it crosses security boundaries. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.ss-owasp-fit EX WF-020 MUST ;; Map OWASP Top 10:2025 categories only when they genuinely fit. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C wf021.ss-scanner-findings OL WF-021,WF-020 MUST ;; When a scanner reports a possible issue inspect the code, decide reachability and relevance, and report only with appropriate confidence. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf020.ss-severity OL WF-020 MUST ;; Severity considers exploitability, exposure, privileges, affected data/capability, blast radius, reliability and compensating controls. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ss-severity-scale EX WF-020 DEFINITION ;; Severity scale: Critical (sparingly), High, Medium, Low, Info. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.ss-false-positives EX SEC-006,SEC-009,SEC-008 DEFINITION ;; Not automatically vulnerabilities: endpoints without [Authorize] under a secure fallback, bare [Authorize] when authentication alone is intended, AllowAnyOrigin for a public non-credentialed API, MD5/SHA1 checksums, no app-level encryption when platform encryption suffices, obvious fake credentials, secure framework defaults. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C sec005.ss-not-safe OL SEC-001,SEC-010,SEC-005 DEFINITION ;; Not automatically safe: secrets in appsettings.Development.json, sensitive values logged at Debug, client-side route guards, hidden UI buttons, CORS as an authorization substitute. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ss-finding-fields EX WF-020 MUST ;; Every confirmed finding includes severity, location, title, evidence, why it is a risk, likely impact, smallest remediation and OWASP category when applicable. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C wf020.ss-needs-verification OL WF-020 MUST ;; Label uncertain items NEEDS VERIFICATION instead of presenting them as confirmed. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf009.ss-layer-status OL WF-009 MUST_NOT ;; Layer status is PASS, FINDINGS, NOT APPLICABLE or NOT CHECKED; never PASS for an uninspected layer. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ss-remediation EX SEC-008,GOV-013 MUST_NOT ;; Prefer the smallest secure change; do not recommend blanket encryption of all fields, security libraries merely to satisfy the scan, or disabling functionality a static scanner cannot understand. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.

C dep012.sw-ui OL DEP-012 DECIDED ;; Swashbuckle Swagger UI is the decided surface; the requirement is the interactive UI, not a standalone raw OpenAPI endpoint. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.sw-config-api-layer EX ARC-012 MUST ;; Keep Swagger configuration in the Api/composition layer. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C dep012.sw-package OL DEP-012,DEP-003 MUST ;; Add Swashbuckle.AspNetCore through add-dependency. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.sw-launch-urls EX WF-006 MUST ;; Application HTTP/HTTPS URLs must agree with the launch profile; never point a browser launch URL to HTTPS on an HTTP-only port. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C api016.sw-accuracy OL API-016 MUST ;; Document only statuses in the real runtime contract (never 201 for 200, 204 with a body, or speculative statuses), considering the whole pipeline (binding, validation, auth, rate limiting, exception handling, middleware). ;; = ;; none ;;
C api003.sw-201 OL API-003 DEFAULT ;; For creation endpoints document 201 and prefer CreatedAtAction/CreatedAtRoute when a canonical URL exists. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.sw-error-contracts EX API-002,API-016 DEFAULT ;; Describe ProblemDetails/ValidationProblemDetails where useful. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C api008.sw-no-internals OL API-008 MUST_NOT ;; Never expose internal exception types, stack traces, SQL, connection strings or paths in Swagger examples. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api016.sw-auth-metadata OL API-016 MUST ;; When the API uses authentication configure the matching security definition; no scheme merely because a package is installed; no global auth requirements on anonymous endpoints. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.sw-descriptions EX API-016 DEFAULT ;; Document what helps consumers (preconditions, idempotency, pagination/filtering, outcomes), not name repetitions; XML comments only when the project chooses them, not on every internal type. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.sw-multiple-docs EX API-016 MUST_NOT ;; Use several documents only for a real contract separation (API versions, public/internal surfaces). ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C api014.sw-generated-clients OL API-014 MUST ;; When the contract feeds client generation treat breaking schema changes seriously and keep metadata accurate. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.sw-client-contracts EX API-016,ARC-029 MUST ;; Avoid unstable anonymous response shapes, use explicit request/response contracts and review generated-client changes when the contract changes. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C wf006.sw-verify OL WF-006,API-016,TST-010 MUST ;; When API behaviour changes verify controller behaviour, integration tests and metadata; start the API when startup changed, open the Development Swagger UI, exercise endpoints when meaningful and preserve newly verified behaviour in tests. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.sw-not-test-substitute EX TST-006 MUST_NOT ;; Swagger is not a substitute for integration tests. ;; = ;; none ;; No owner clause for this item.

C x.tm-capability-placement EX - MUST ;; Implementation-specific content of a slot becomes a facet listed in the module manifest with 'Capability: <slot>/<implementation>'; implementation-independent slot policy stays in the neutral standard; placement belongs to the architecture frame, technique to leaves declaring frame bindings in Binds:. ;; repo/meta (instruction-system change) ;; none ;; Instruction-system placement rule.
C x.tm-scope-globs EX - MUST ;; A rule's paths include its scope's canonical glob (**/*, backend/**/*, backend/**/*Tests/**/*, frontend/**/*); no other directory hierarchy under .claude/rules/. ;; = ;; none ;; Instruction-system rule.
C x.tm-one-owner EX - MUST ;; Every normative statement has exactly one owner; elsewhere only a routing pointer, a check-by-reference item or a register decision summary. ;; = ;; none ;; Instruction-system rule.
C x.tm-trigger-role EX - MUST ;; Keep the trigger role: always-loaded policy in OP/DEC, path policy in STD, procedure obligations in WF; do not move content between roles to save tokens; never place critical must-policy only in a skill. ;; = ;; none ;; Instruction-system rule.
C x.tm-leak-rule EX - MUST_NOT ;; Outside a module's facets, manifest, the register's selection block and the map, never name the selected implementation; facet file names are role-based. ;; = ;; none ;; Instruction-system rule.
C x.tm-header EX - MUST ;; Start each artifact with the header 'Kind | Scope | Capability | Loading' (after required frontmatter). ;; = ;; none ;; Instruction-system rule.
C x.tm-skill-frontmatter EX - MUST ;; Skill frontmatter name equals the directory and the description is concise and trigger-first; WF bodies own procedure and output; KNW bodies own technique and point to standards for policy. ;; = ;; none ;; Instruction-system rule.
C x.tm-capability-changes EX ARC-020 MUST ;; Capability changes follow architecture-decision (contract coverage, single implementation per slot, no unselected implementations at runtime). ;; = ;; none ;; Instruction-system rule.
C x.tm-update-manifest-map EX - MUST ;; Update the module manifest's facet table and both MAP views for every added, moved or removed artifact. ;; = ;; none ;; Instruction-system rule.
C x.tm-hooks EX - MUST ;; Hooks use exec form (node + [dispatch.cjs launcher, event]); the launcher only locates code while checks use the active root from the hook input cwd; the PreToolUse guard keeps onFailure block; post and Stop hooks stay advisory; hook messages point to owners. ;; = ;; none ;; Instruction-system rule.
C x.tm-enf-conforms EX - MUST ;; ENF artifacts declare their policy owners on the line after the header ('Conforms: …' or '—') and every cited owner path is declared; slot bindings and facet roles are fixed; contract and manifest Binds agree. ;; = ;; none ;; Instruction-system rule.
C x.tm-run-checker EX - MUST ;; Run check-instructions with the active root and fix every error; review the always-loaded size and keep it compact without moving required planning-time policy out. ;; = ;; none ;; Instruction-system rule.

33 NN ;; Heading.
35 MX [wf005.vf-tests,wf018.vf-test-script,x.vf-suite-scope] ;; Running relevant tests, investigating failures and inspecting package.json restate WF-005/WF-018; full-suite vs affected-first scoping is added.

56 EX [x.vf-instr-check]
58 NN ;; Heading.
60 MX [wf004.vf-final-diff,x.vf-final-diff-items,gov003.vf-spec-drift,gov021.vf-stale,tst010.vf-probes] ;; Accidental edits, architecture drift, specification drift, stale settings surfaces and unpreserved probes restate WF-004/GOV-003/GOV-021/TST-010; commented-out code, temporary logging, TODO/FIXME markers and stale temporary tests are added.
62 OL [run010.vf-usings]
64 NN ;; Heading.
66 OL [wf008.vf-fix-retry,wf008.vf-no-hide]
68 NN ;; Heading.
70 OL [wf009.vf-report]
72-82 DU [wf009.vf-report,gov017.dw-report-unresolved] ;; Report template restating the status vocabulary and open Decision Requests.

C wf003.vf-goal OL WF-003,WF-007 MUST ;; Produce evidence that the change is complete without obvious regressions, matched to scope and risk, without requiring unconfigured optional tooling. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf004.vf-inspect OL WF-004,TST-010 MUST ;; Review the final changed files and diff first: scope match without unrelated refactoring, temporary probes removed only after their behaviour is preserved, no generated/build artifacts, no secrets or environment credentials (remove any). ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf007.vf-affected-areas OL WF-004,WF-007 MUST ;; Determine affected areas (backend-only, frontend-only, contract/full-stack, documentation-only without unrelated builds). ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf005.vf-build OL WF-005 MUST ;; Build the affected solution or projects; a build failure means the implementation is not complete. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf018.vf-build-script OL WF-018 MUST ;; For frontend changes inspect package.json and run the declared build script. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.vf-no-restore EX WF-005 MUST_NOT ;; Do not use --no-restore unless restore is known to be complete. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C wf005.vf-tests OL WF-005 MUST ;; Run tests covering the changed area and investigate every newly failing relevant test; never dismiss one as unrelated without checking. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf018.vf-test-script OL WF-018 MUST ;; Run the frontend's declared test script when one exists; inspect package.json rather than assuming a runner. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.vf-suite-scope EX WF-005 DEFAULT ;; Small solutions run the full suite; large solutions run affected test projects first, then the broader suite required. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C wf006.vf-smoke OL WF-006 DEFAULT ;; For new runnable applications or substantial composition/startup/configuration/persistence/full-stack changes verify Development startup (host, endpoint, Swagger UI, configuration binding, database initialization, frontend dev server, compatible API base URL and CORS); a build alone does not prove runtime composition. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst010.vf-probes OL TST-010 MUST ;; Behaviour uniquely demonstrated by an ad-hoc/manual probe must be represented by maintained automated tests before completion unless confirmed equivalent coverage exists; builds, compilers, formatters, analysis and existing suites need no new tests. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf007.vf-risk-scoped OL WF-007 MUST ;; Run architecture, formatting/analyzer, dependency and security checks when relevant, not indiscriminately. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.vf-root-aware-commands EX - MUST ;; Run checker commands by absolute path (node "<root>/.claude/scripts/<checker>.cjs", root from git rev-parse --show-toplevel or the directory holding CLAUDE.md and .claude/). ;; repo/meta ;; none ;; Command-form rule not in the oracle.

C x.ec-modern-syntax EX RUN-009 ENFORCED_ADVISORY ;; Primary constructors (silent), collection expressions and switch expressions (suggestion), pattern matching (silent). ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
